summary_en: Culture Convenience Club tender offer for Jimoty closed 2026-06-29. 8,658,670 shares tendered (exceeds 6,560,000 minimum). Offer accepted in full. Settlement begins 2026-07-06. CCC to become parent company (>50% voting rights). NTT DoCoMo ceases to be lead shareholder. Proto Corporation and CEO Takahiro Katō cease to be major shareholders.
title_en: Notice of Results of Tender Offer for Jimoty Inc. Shares by Culture Convenience Club Co., Ltd. and Changes in Parent Company and Major Shareholders
translation_en_brief: Culture Convenience Club Co., Ltd. (CCC) launched a tender offer for Jimoty Inc. common shares and warrants on 2026-05-18. The offer closed on 2026-06-29 with 8,658,670 shares and warrant equivalents tendered, exceeding the minimum threshold of 6,560,000 shares. CCC has accepted all tendered securities. Settlement is scheduled to begin 2026-07-06, at which point CCC's voting-rights ownership will exceed 50%, making it Jimoty's parent company and lead shareholder. Current lead shareholder NTT DoCoMo and major shareholders Proto Corporation and CEO Takahiro Katō will cease to hold those statuses post-settlement. Jimoty and CCC have a commercial relationship based on a co-creation framework agreement signed 2025-07-07 for addressing regional social challenges. Tender offer price and total consideration are not disclosed in this excerpt.
